exergy-loss-irreversibility-law-79de98ce.title: Exergy Loss (Energy Quality Degradation)
exergy-loss-irreversibility-law-79de98ce.interpretation: Quantifies the amount of usable work (exergy) remaining in the universe, which monotonically decreases as high-quality energy is dissipated into random thermal motion.
exergy-loss-irreversibility-law-79de98ce.symmetry_origin: The irreversible nature of the Second Law of Thermodynamics and the dissipation of macroscopic gradients.
exergy-loss-irreversibility-law-79de98ce.limits_and_boundary: As $T \to T_{death}$, the value of X vanishes, leaving only unusable thermal energy.

fermi-surface-topology-definition-5d5ccd.title: Fermi Surface (Constant Energy)
fermi-surface-topology-definition-5d5ccd.interpretation: Defines the constant-energy manifold in reciprocal space that separates occupied electronic states from unoccupied states at absolute zero temperature.
fermi-surface-topology-definition-5d5ccd.symmetry_origin: The Pauli Exclusion Principle and the construction of the Fermi sea in a periodic potential.
fermi-surface-topology-definition-5d5ccd.limits_and_boundary: Only exists for metals where the chemical potential intersects at least one energy band; for insulators, the Fermi surface is empty.
